title.wall_note: EXTERIOR WALLS 9" THK., INTERNAL WALLS 4 1/2" THK. (NOT CALLED OUT ON SKETCH - DERIVED FROM THE DIMENSION ARITHMETIC)

notes: FIRST FLOOR PLAN. Floor level written on the sketch inside the Lobby: Lvl. +13'-6".
ROAD is on the south (bottom) side of the plot.

Stair mouth: NO wall is listed between the Lobby and the Staircase along x = 14.5625 from y = 16.2292 to y = 23.8125 - the sketch shows only two piers there and the opening between them is left clear.

Stair riser numbering read off the sketch: flight 1 risers 24 - 32 climbing EAST; winders 33, 34, 35 at the EAST end with the red arrows pointing SOUTH; flight 2 risers 36 - 44 climbing WEST. East, then south, then west = two right-hand turns, so the ascent circulates CLOCKWISE with the landing at the far (east) end.
UP arrow enters the stair from the WEST (Lobby) side at the north flight; DN is marked at the west end of the south flight.
The Passage is open to the north-west Open Terrace at its north end - no wall is listed across x = 6.5625 to 10.4375 at y = 28.9792.
V1 vents the north-east Toilet into the O.T.S shaft; W2 borrows light into Master Bed Room 2 from the same shaft.
OP-2 is a leafless opening connecting Dress to Master Bed Room 1.
Planter is a narrow open strip on the south side, under the south-east Open Terrace only; it does not run the full plot width.
assumptions: NO compass or north point is drawn on the sketch. north_deg = 90 (north up the sheet) has been assumed, keeping the sketch's own paper orientation with the ROAD to the south.

NO wall-thickness callout appears anywhere on the sketch. 9" exterior and 4 1/2" internal were DERIVED, not assumed arbitrarily: with those values the written clear sizes close exactly on the 25'-0" overall in both the north band (9'-10" + 5'-9 1/2" + 7'-10 1/2") and the south band (14'-0" + 9'-10 1/2"), and the left and right vertical stacks independently both close on 37'-1 1/2".

Overall dimensions have been read as centre-line dimensions per the coordinate rules. The 25' closes exactly. The 40' is the PLOT depth - the building's centre-line stack is 37'-1 1/2", so the south exterior wall centre-line lands at y = 2.875 and the planter's outer wall at y = 1.375, leaving a small open strip to the road.

The O.T.S is written 5'-9 1/2" x 4'-1 1/2", but the sketch draws its south wall flush with the north-east Toilet's south wall and its east wall as the Toilet's party wall. Geometry has been driven by Master Bed Room 2 (14'-0" x 10'-9") and the Toilet (7'-10 1/2" x 4'-6"), which are the controlling dimensions, so the O.T.S resolves to 5'-9" x 4'-6" on the grid. The size_label is retained exactly as written on the sketch.
The north-west Open Terrace is written 9'-10" wide; driving the grid off Master Bed Room 2 = 14'-0" makes it 9'-10 1/2". The 1/2" discrepancy is absorbed in the terrace.

W1 is not legibly tagged in the supplied render, but W1 is the only missing window tag (W2, W3 and W4 are all present) and an opening with a projecting sill box is drawn in the west Toilet's north wall onto the north-west Open Terrace. It has been recorded there. Its width (4'-6") is scaled off the drawing, not written.
Window widths W1, W2, W3, W4 and the OP-2 width are scaled off the sketch - no dimensions are written against them.
Door widths are scaled: D1 and D3 taken as 3'-0", the two D4 toilet doors as 2'-6". No door widths are written on the sketch.

D3 is drawn with its leaf swept on the Open Terrace side. It has been encoded opening INWARD into Master Bed Room 1, hinged at the south jamb so the leaf folds flat along the bedroom's south wall, in accordance with the door rule.
The lower D1 is drawn with a small gap between its east jamb and the spine pier. It has been placed hard against the spine (pos 11.375) so the leaf folds flat along that wall.

The upper D1 at the Lobby / Passage wall reads as hinged on the west jamb, swinging north into the Passage and folding against the Toilet-Dress east wall. The sketch's arc is small and this hinge side is the less certain of the two possible readings.

Stair treads (9 per flight) are inferred from the riser numbering 24-32 and 36-44; the tread going is not dimensioned. The well_gap of 1'-6" is scaled off the X-hatched void drawn between the flights.
The strip of plot south of the planter and west of it (y = 0 to 2.875) is unlabelled on the sketch and has NOT been listed as a room.

Zoomed re-reads of the sketch were not possible - image-cropping commands were blocked by the sandbox - so all readings are from full-size inspection of the supplied render. Positions scaled by eye carry roughly +/- 6" uncertainty; all written dimensions have been honoured exactly.
No project name, client, drawing number or date appears on the sketch; those title fields are left blank.
